# Astronomical v0.2.103
### New - Speech: Astronomical can now speak text with native Kokoro-82M and Phonon 31M speech engines. Use `astronomical speak` in the terminal or `POST /v1/audio/speech` on the local API. Speech is no longer experimental. - The chat window has a Speak button that reads a reply aloud. - First launch shows a plain get-started journey in place of the earlier welcome. - Observatory's Configuration page is now two pages, Settings and Tuning, with a plain title, unit and explanation for each setting.
### Improved - Astro is drawn as a dot galaxy and no longer sits in the message field. - The decision model catalog records Clef's measured peak memory. - The Download for Mac buttons on the website and README lead straight to the disk image.
### Fixed - Double-clicking the chat window's top strip zooms the window again, and the strip drags like a title bar.
### Compatibility - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. - Settings, chats, downloaded models and the Library are preserved. No configuration field was removed. - The app is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed update feed.
